name: The Last Tower
source:
The Last Tower stands amid a ruined world. 

People have trapped themselves in a domain to keep the monsters away. Only a handful selected Children of Naga, each with a unique special power called Manifestations, ascend the tower to tear it down.

This is the story of one of the Children of Naga who aspire to see the top of the tower.

[From [url=https://karita0101.itch.io/the-last-tower]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
最后的塔矗立在一片废墟之中。

人们将自己困在一个领域中以驱赶怪物。只有极少数被选中的纳迦之子，每个人都具有独特的特殊力量，称为显现者，登上塔楼并将其拆毁。

这是一位娜迦之子渴望登上塔顶的故事。

[来自[url=https://karita0101.itch.io/the-last-tower]itch.io[/url]]
